items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens; deal expected completed this weekend. Fills void from Lamar/Huntley injuries.
items.why: BAL QB crisis after Lamar thumb and Huntley toe; ARI demoted Brissett post-Minshew emergence.
items.implication: Brissett likely Week 10+ starter BAL; ARI locks Minshew, McBride volume may shift slightly.
items.opportunity: BAL skill (Flowers/Andrews) stabilize ROS with vet QB; ARI RBs/WRs more pass-game dependent on Minshew.

items.text: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley suffered season-ending turf toe; tests confirm, surgery ahead. Lamar out indefinitely, Joe Fagnano starts Thursday vs JAX.
items.why: Turf toe confirmed season-ending after Week 8.
items.implication: Complete BAL QB wipeout; Fagnano emergency start TNF, Brissett incoming.
items.opportunity: JAX D/ST elite play; BAL skill players volatile until Brissett.

items.text: BAL loses Lamar Jackson, likely for the season after thumb injury requiring surgery; placed on IR path.
items.why: Thumb injury on first snap vs BUF; coach confirms surgery and possible season-ending.
items.implication: Massive downgrade to BAL pass game and Zay Flowers/Mark Andrews volume short-term; Fagnano starts TNF.
items.opportunity: Short-term Fagnano/Brissett arrival; long-term Flowers/Andrews if scheme holds.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love headed to IR with high-ankle sprain, out 4-5 weeks. Previously dealing with different ankle issue.
items.why: High-ankle sprain re-aggravated in OT win vs DAL.
items.implication: ARI RB room thin; Bam Knight also concussion Q.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RBs elevated; committee or Knight if clears.

items.text: Yes, I am KEEPING IT OPEN on Ladd McConkey this week. As a WR3. Let’s not get carried away. Favorable HOU matchup (4th-most FP to WRs).
items.why: Matchup vs HOU D allowing high WR fantasy points; reasonable WR3 expectations.
items.implication: Startable flex/WR3 in Week 9; hold ROS.
items.opportunity: Target share in LAC offense vs soft secondary.

items.text: 49ers: Nick Bosa returns to practice. RB Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) and WR Mike Evans won’t practice Wednesday.
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri for Week 9 availability; vet rest possible but flags risk.
items.opportunity: If out, backup RBs/WRs (e.g. others in SF) spike.

items.text: AJ Brown misses another game due to lingering knee issue.
items.why: Lingering knee; ETR flags multi-game miss.
items.implication: NE/PHI? WR corps thin; boost to other pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Handcuff WRs or TE elevated targets/routes.

items.text: Wheels completely fall off for IND, Jonathan Taylor saga continues.
items.why: Ongoing saga/injury/role issues flagged in Week 9 preview pod.
items.implication: Volatility for JT owners; monitor IND backfield.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs or committee mates if limited.

items.text: Mike Washington Jr. handed LV workhorse RB role Week 8 (25-2 carry edge over Ashton Jeanty). Workload noteworthy though stickiness TBD; top waiver discussion.
items.why: 25-2 carries Washington over Jeanty in Week 8.
items.implication: Jeanty role reduced; Washington waiver priority if available.
items.opportunity: Jeanty handcuff or Washington add for volume.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) remained sidelined Wednesday; not counting on return this weekend vs NYG.
items.opportunity: Dallas Goedert or backups spike targets.

items.text: Buccaneers WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) did not practice Wednesday; no better than 50/50 vs CHI SNF.
items.implication: TB WR depth tested if out.

items.text: Bhayshul Tuten remained non-participant (ankle/foot); listed Questionable for Week 9.
items.implication: Game-time; if out, JAC RB committee shifts.
